articles.title: Banks pass on rate hikes, but go slow when rates fall; RBI study finds
articles.summary: A recent study by the RBI indicates that banks are more responsive to interest rate hikes than to cuts. Specifically, banks relayed 76.4% of repo rate increases, while only 64% of reductions were passed on. Amid periods of tightening, lending rates surged significantly, in contrast to the minimal decreases observed during easing. This research highlights the intricate dynamics of interest rate adjustments, particularly affecting sectors like MSMEs.

articles.title: India brings back duties on specified Chinese titanium dioxide imports
articles.summary: India has reintroduced anti-dumping duties on titanium dioxide imports from China due to material injury caused to domestic producers. This action follows a recommendation from the Directorate General of Trade Remedies, which concluded that Chinese imports were sold at dumped prices. The duties will be effective for five years unless revoked or amended. This decision comes after the Calcutta High Court ordered a reconsideration of a previous duty case.

articles.title: Explainer: Why pension funds are becoming key buyers of India's large-cap stocks
articles.summary: Pension funds are gaining prominence in India's equity markets, with purchases of large-cap stocks surpassing those by mutual funds over the past 12 months, according to Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC's Harish Krishnan. However, limited allocation headroom in dynamic asset allocation funds and uncertainty over crude oil prices and West Asia could weigh on the near-term outlook.
